text:
ida: Kicking off follow-up on the 'experiment-stage shepherd' idea — want to nail down how runtime consumes fallback signals and what the safety handshake looks like. TL;DR: how do we wire canary metrics -> decision -> automatic fallback?
chris: +1. Quick Q: who owns the shepherd component (configing probes, policy)?
sumi: I can take shepherd config ownership if that helps. My proposal: shepherd emits a small canonical signal blob: {probe_score, latency_p95, error_rate, sample_size} and a decision token when thresholds tripped.
tal: runtime needs a stable API for that token. Prefer a proto like: 
```proto
message ShepherdSignal {
  float probe_score = 1;
  double latency_p95 = 2;
  float error_rate = 3;
  int32 sample_size = 4;
  string decision = 5; // OK | WARN | FAIL
}
```
chris: that looks fine. We should also include an urn for which rollout/session it came from (tenant + rollout id).
maria: telemetry note — make sure shepherd signals are emitted to redwood-evals and to tracing. We need prompt-sets mapped to canary buckets to correlate quality regressions.
sumi: agreed. Minimal config we need: thresholds and a fallback plan list. Example config idea: 
```yaml
thresholds:
  probe_score: 0.7
  error_rate: 0.05
  min_samples: 100
fallback_plan:
  - fallback_variant: model-small-1
  - route: region-fallback
  - degrade: reduce_max_tokens
```
tal: runtime questions: 1) sync vs async decision application? 2) what about partial failures across replicas? 3) do we allow per-request hedging when shepherd is WARN?
ida: my thoughts — decisions should be asynchronously pushable but applied atomically per-call path if possible. If shepherd says FAIL for a rollout, routing must flip for new requests only (no in-flight swaps). For partial replica failures we should have a graded fallback (see below).
chris: graded fallback ordering proposal: 1) local model-variant pin (same host) 2) smaller quantized variant 3) cross-region pool 4) fallback to cached response 5) degrade features (truncate, lower temp).
maria: add signal cooldown and recovery window. If probe_score goes back above 0.8 for two windows we unfreeze. Also log a gate event to audit trail.
sumi: implementation plan: shepherd service emits signals at window intervals (1m), writes to key-value strip for runtime to poll, and also posts to control-plane pubsub for observers. Runtime subscribes and applies policy decisions from the pubsub.
tal: sounds OK but polling KV is simpler for private deployments (no pubsub). We'll implement dual-path: pubsub primary, KV fallback. Document interface clearly.
deploy-bot: @channel Canary started: rollout/exp-742 blue=10% start=1718501300.
chris: when the shepherd triggers an automatic fallback, we should create an incident-lite with a pre-filled checklist (rollback? scale up?). Any objections?
maria: +1. Pre-fill with metrics snapshot and sample prompts. Also attach the latest eval delta.
ida: action items: @sumi to draft shepherd API + config by EOW, @tal to sketch runtime subscription modes and atomicity constraints, @maria to define eval mappings. We'll sync Thurs 11am.
sumi: noted, will post a short RFC link once ready. :thumbsup:
tal: will prototype probe consumer in the canary agent this week.
chris: thanks all. If anyone wants to catch up before Thurs ping me or drop notes here.
ida: wrapping — thanks.
